description: Inserts in before bare month/year tokens only in whitelisted time-expression contexts.
fp_risk_note: Medium risk. Years can be quantities or noun modifiers. Rule must block year/month tokens followed by nouns and avoid broad numeric rewriting.

positive.notes: Born context takes in before a bare year.
Moved-here context takes in before a bare month.
Arrived context takes in before a bare past year.

negative.notes: Year as noun modifier stays unchanged.
Month as sentence subject stays unchanged.
FP guard (different context verb): 'came' is outside the context set {was/were born, moved here, arrived}; rule abstains.

negative.input: I was born March in Hanoi.
negative.expectedCorrection: I was born March in Hanoi.
negative.notes: FP guard (token not at sentence end): the matcher requires the month/year token at the end; 'March' is mid-sentence, so it abstains.
FP guard (future-year): 'arrive' is a context verb and '2099' is at the end, but the past-year guard blocks non-past years; rule abstains.
FP guard (question, no trailing token): 'were born' with no month/year token at the end; rule abstains.
FP guard (non-year token): 'moved here' is a context verb but '5 years ago' is not a month name or 4-digit year; rule abstains.
